### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

# Industrial Printers, Coders and Markers

Domino Printing UK (Domino UK Ltd) is the UK division of Domino Printing Sciences a Coding and
Marking company - a global expert in industrial printers. Specialising in digital printing and
traceability solutions (such as industrial coders) for sectors as diverse as food, beverage, life
sciences, packaging, cleaning, personal care, building and construction.

Our technology prints onto products you encounter every day including cans, household goods, eggs,
ready meals, cartons, glass, cases, pallets, PET, trays, film, labels and much, much more.

Domino’s family of industrial markers includes diverse technologies such as [continuous inkjet][84],
laser, thermal transfer overprinting, thermal inkjet, print and apply labellers, case coders and
more.

Domino provides total support through advanced services and packages such as Domino Cloud remote
monitoring, SafeGuard aftermarket extended warranty contracts, SafeSupply bundled consumable
agreements including inks, fluids, ribbons, printheads and labels, Relax flexible finance options
such as operational leases, as well as a training academy and 500 fully trained service technicians
delivering global service excellence globally to ensure customers meet their goals.

Get in touch with one of our team today and experience how Domino can do more for you.

Read More

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real
consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing
safety on site.]

## Intelligence set in motion.

Across the globe, companies run their most critical operations on our technologies. Today, we
harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that
continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

customers already rely on, adding intelligence that learns from their operations, proposes
improvements, and acts only with their approval.

industries.

# Packaging Line Automation Solutions - Leading Packaging Equipment Manufacturer

BellatRx is a leading packaging equipment manufacturer of [complete packaging lines][45] and
packaging machines and your number one source for innovative, advanced, and automated packaging and
[filling solutions][46]. Our expertise lies in the engineering and manufacturing of innovative
equipment designed to your specification for a turnkey operation. We create and manufacture [ liquid
filling machines][47] and monoblocs, [solid-dose filling machines][48], [cappers and torquers][49],
[labelers][50],[ bottle unscramblers][51], [banding and sleeving machines][52], [conveyors][53], and
accumulation and recovery systems focusing on Rigid Containers.

## Your Front of Line Starts Here.™

Every great product has a beginning. And it starts at the Front of Line™, where your product is
filled, sealed, labeled, and brought to life. At BellatRx, this is our specialty. For decades, we’ve
helped companies transform their Front of Line into powerful launchpads for their brands.

[ Learn More ][54]
[capping-and-torquing]

## Capping And Torquing

Our [capping machines][55] are designed for production lines that need to cap bottles of any kind.
We provide a wide range of advanced capping machines designed to handle threaded, press-on, crimped
caps, and more with precision torque control. Our cappers can handle most capping production needs,
from large containers to high-speed applications requiring accurate, repeatable capping. We’ve also
made installation easier with a more forgiven, easier setup process than most other capping machines
out there.

[ Learn More ][56]

][58] [ Capping Machine for Large Containers ][59] [ Capping Machine for Pump Caps ][60] [ Screw Cap
Low Reject Capping Machine ][61] [ Rotary Capping Machine ][62] [ Torquing Machine ][63] [ Plugging
Machine ][64]
[Liquid Filling Machine]

## Liquid Filling Machines

Automatic and semi-automatic [liquid filling machines][65] are designed to handle both non-viscous
and viscous liquids, accommodating various container shapes and materials. They can be customized
with options like [piston fillers][66], pump fillers, and flow meter fillers. Our liquid fillers
feature the most advanced servo-driven technology to give our customers the best service possible.

# Packaging Line Automation Solutions - Leading Packaging Equipment Manufacturer

BellatRx is a leading packaging equipment manufacturer of [complete packaging lines][45] and
packaging machines and your number one source for innovative, advanced, and automated packaging and
[filling solutions][46]. Our expertise lies in the engineering and manufacturing of innovative
equipment designed to your specification for a turnkey operation. We create and manufacture [ liquid

[labelers][50],[ bottle unscramblers][51], [banding and sleeving machines][52], [conveyors][53], and
accumulation and recovery systems focusing on Rigid Containers.

## Your Front of Line Starts Here.™

Every great product has a beginning. And it starts at the Front of Line™, where your product is
filled, sealed, labeled, and brought to life. At BellatRx, this is our specialty. For decades, we’ve

[ Learn More ][67]

VP-1 & VP-1S Piston Fillers - Filling Semi-Viscous Liquids & Creams ][72]
[gummies out of jar]

## Gummy Packaging Lines

BellatRx’s Gemini Gummy Counting Machine is a high-speed, vision-based system designed to accurately
count and fill various types of gummies and sticky candies. It solves the traditional challenge of
counting gummies by using advanced image analysis technology, ensuring 99.99% accuracy. The machine
features a compact design, easy installation, floor level bulk feed hopper, and a dual-lane
conveyor. This gummy counting machine can handle gummies with any kind of coating due to its
de-clumping system and an automated cleated elevator that prevents gummy blockages.

[ Learn More ][73]
[Powder Filling Machines]

## Complete Powder Filling Lines

BellatRx’s powder filling lines are designed for the food, pharmaceutical, and nutraceutical
industries. These automated systems fill dry powders and granules into various container sizes and
shapes. Two key lines are available: the Nutritional Powders Pharma Line and the Nutritional Powder
Food Line. The Pharma Line packages powders, food, spices, and nutraceuticals with auger filling,
weight verification, and tamper-evident sleeving. The Food Line features twin auger fillers, live
weight monitoring, torque-controlled capping, and a Notaris wrap labeler with dust control.

[ Learn More ][74]
[Solid Dose Counter & Filler]

## Tablet Counting Machines

BellatRx’s tablet counting and bottle filling machines are precise, automated systems designed to
accurately count and fill bottles with tablets, capsules, and soft gels. Created specifically for
the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, these machines ensure dosage accuracy to a greater
degree than other counting machines on the market. A tablet bottle and packing machine eliminates
the need to measure out doses manually, separating, filling, and rejoining capsule caps and bodies.
Dosage quality is ensured by detecting damaged tablets and preventing contamination during the
filling process.

[ Learn More ][75]
[Notaris-PLUS-Labeler-Thumbnail]

## Labeling Machines

BellatRx’s labeling machines provide efficient and accurate label application on jars, bottles,
cartons, trays, and more through the use of automation. These machines feature servo-controlled
motion, automated setup, and real-time feedback through LED indicators, allowing even untrained
operators to easily handle setup. Our labeling machines are pressure sensitive and support a wide
range of label types, including barcodes, batch codes, and logos. Their durability, ease of use, and
ability to streamline production make them a valuable investment for any manufacturing facility.

[ Learn More ][76]

## Complete Packaging Automation Lines for North American & International Markets

Manufacturers across the United States, Canada, and international markets depend on BellatRx for
complete packaging automation solutions and standalone machinery. Operating out of Quebec, Canada,
our team designs and builds the filling, capping, labeling, counting, and integrated packaging
systems required by the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, beverage, cosmetic, chemical, and
personal care industries. By combining customized turnkey configurations with global support and
modern technology, we help companies maximize their daily packaging output, accuracy, and
performance worldwide.

# Packaging Line Automation Solutions - Leading Packaging Equipment Manufacturer

BellatRx is a leading packaging equipment manufacturer of [complete packaging lines][45] and
packaging machines and your number one source for innovative, advanced, and automated packaging and
[filling solutions][46]. Our expertise lies in the engineering and manufacturing of innovative
equipment designed to your specification for a turnkey operation. We create and manufacture [ liquid
filling machines][47] and monoblocs, [solid-dose filling machines][48], [cappers and torquers][49],
[labelers][50],[ bottle unscramblers][51], [banding and sleeving machines][52], [conveyors][53], and
accumulation and recovery systems focusing on Rigid Containers.

## Your Front of Line Starts Here.™

Every great product has a beginning. And it starts at the Front of Line™, where your product is
filled, sealed, labeled, and brought to life. At BellatRx, this is our specialty. For decades, we’ve
helped companies transform their Front of Line into powerful launchpads for their brands.

[ Learn More ][54]
[capping-and-torquing]

## Capping And Torquing

Our [capping machines][55] are designed for production lines that need to cap bottles of any kind.
We provide a wide range of advanced capping machines designed to handle threaded, press-on, crimped
caps, and more with precision torque control. Our cappers can handle most capping production needs,
from large containers to high-speed applications requiring accurate, repeatable capping. We’ve also
made installation easier with a more forgiven, easier setup process than most other capping machines
out there.

## Liquid Filling Machines

Automatic and semi-automatic [liquid filling machines][65] are designed to handle both non-viscous
and viscous liquids, accommodating various container shapes and materials. They can be customized
with options like [piston fillers][66], pump fillers, and flow meter fillers. Our liquid fillers
feature the most advanced servo-driven technology to give our customers the best service possible.

## Gummy Packaging Lines

BellatRx’s Gemini Gummy Counting Machine is a high-speed, vision-based system designed to accurately
count and fill various types of gummies and sticky candies. It solves the traditional challenge of
counting gummies by using advanced image analysis technology, ensuring 99.99% accuracy. The machine
features a compact design, easy installation, floor level bulk feed hopper, and a dual-lane
conveyor. This gummy counting machine can handle gummies with any kind of coating due to its
de-clumping system and an automated cleated elevator that prevents gummy blockages.

[ Learn More ][73]
[Powder Filling Machines]

## Complete Powder Filling Lines

BellatRx’s powder filling lines are designed for the food, pharmaceutical, and nutraceutical
industries. These automated systems fill dry powders and granules into various container sizes and
shapes. Two key lines are available: the Nutritional Powders Pharma Line and the Nutritional Powder
Food Line. The Pharma Line packages powders, food, spices, and nutraceuticals with auger filling,
weight verification, and tamper-evident sleeving. The Food Line features twin auger fillers, live
weight monitoring, torque-controlled capping, and a Notaris wrap labeler with dust control.

[ Learn More ][74]

## Tablet Counting Machines

BellatRx’s tablet counting and bottle filling machines are precise, automated systems designed to
accurately count and fill bottles with tablets, capsules, and soft gels. Created specifically for
the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, these machines ensure dosage accuracy to a greater
degree than other counting machines on the market. A tablet bottle and packing machine eliminates
the need to measure out doses manually, separating, filling, and rejoining capsule caps and bodies.
Dosage quality is ensured by detecting damaged tablets and preventing contamination during the
filling process.

[ Learn More ][75]

## Labeling Machines

BellatRx’s labeling machines provide efficient and accurate label application on jars, bottles,
cartons, trays, and more through the use of automation. These machines feature servo-controlled
motion, automated setup, and real-time feedback through LED indicators, allowing even untrained
operators to easily handle setup. Our labeling machines are pressure sensitive and support a wide
range of label types, including barcodes, batch codes, and logos. Their durability, ease of use, and
ability to streamline production make them a valuable investment for any manufacturing facility.

[ Learn More ][76]

## Complete Packaging Automation Lines for North American & International Markets

Manufacturers across the United States, Canada, and international markets depend on BellatRx for
complete packaging automation solutions and standalone machinery. Operating out of Quebec, Canada,
our team designs and builds the filling, capping, labeling, counting, and integrated packaging
systems required by the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, beverage, cosmetic, chemical, and
personal care industries. By combining customized turnkey configurations with global support and
modern technology, we help companies maximize their daily packaging output, accuracy, and
performance worldwide.

Businesses can schedule a pickup. Residential customers can mail-in or schedule a pickup for a fee

Provide as much detail as possible. e.g 5 computers, 3 printers, 2 laptops, etc.

Beyond Surplus is registered with the State of Georgia as a certified electronics recycler and
operates under a strict zero-landfill policy for all electronic waste. No equipment processed
through Beyond Surplus is sent to a landfill, and no hazardous materials are exported to other
countries. All downstream vendors are R2 certified, meaning every link in the recycling chain meets
the same environmental and data security standards we hold ourselves to. For organizations with ESG
reporting requirements or sustainability mandates, this documentation is available as part of every
load processed.

Our expertise spans the complete packaging spectrum:
* **State-of-the-Art Equipment**: From horizontal flow wrappers and vertical form-fill-seal systems
  to mini baggers and specialized equipment for coffee pods, we provide both fully automated
  production systems and compact tabletop solutions.
* **Premium Packaging Materials**: We offer a wide selection of packaging films, pre-formed bags,
  and specialty materials designed to enhance product freshness and visual appeal.
* **Quality Control Systems**: Our metal detectors and checkweighers help maintain product safety
  and regulatory compliance.

## The Barrington Advantage

What sets us apart is our commitment to your business success:
* **Customized Approach**: We understand that every operation is unique. Our team works closely with
  you to develop tailored packaging solutions that align perfectly with your brand values and
  operational goals.
* **Cost Reduction Focus**: Our systems are specifically designed to lower packaging and labor costs
  while improving packaging quality and efficiency.
* **Expert Guidance**: With decades of industry experience, our consultants provide invaluable
  assistance in selecting the right packaging solutions for your specific needs.
* **Exceptional Support**: From initial consultation through installation, training, and ongoing
  maintenance, our dedicated team ensures your packaging operations run smoothly.

## Transform Your Packaging Operation Today

Don't let outdated packaging methods limit your potential. Contact us today at [888-814-7999][226]
and discover how Barrington Packaging Systems Group can help you achieve packaging excellence that
drives business growth.

2025-10-07

There are a wide variety of lighters on the market, each with its own unique characteristics,
categorized by ignition mechanism, fuel type, flame characteristics, and usage scenarios.
 Classification by Ignition Mechanism • Flint and Steel Wheel Lighter: A classic design, igniting by
the friction of a flint and steel wheel. Simple and durable.   • Piezoelectric Ceramic Lighter:
Utilizes the piezoelectric effect to generate a high-voltage electric spark. Easy to operate, but
relatively less durable.   • Magnetic Induction Lighter: Highly technological, uses the principle of
magnetic induction to generate an electric spark.   • Battery Lighter: Battery-powered, ignites via
a heating wire or arc. No open flame, highly safe.   Classification by Fuel • Gas Lighter: Uses
liquefied gases such as butane and propane. Ignites quickly and has a stable flame. Most common.   •
Kerosene Lighter: Uses kerosene as fuel. Features a classic design and high durability, but the
ignition rate can be unstable.   • Electronic Lighter: Battery-powered, ignites via a heating wire
or arc. No open flame, suitable for everyday use.   Classification by Flame Type • Open Flame
Lighter: Produces a visible flame. Suitable for a variety of situations, but poses safety risks.   •
Arc Lighters: Use electric current to generate an arc for ignition, eliminating the need for open
flames and offering increased safety. Suitable for those who are fire-shy or seek a more
technologically advanced experience.   Classification by Usage Scenario • Windproof Lighters:

magnetic induction to generate an electric spark.   • Battery Lighter: Battery-powered, ignites via

liquefied gases such as butane and propane. Ignites quickly and has a stable flame. Most common.   •

Small but Powerful! The 5961 label print and apply system gives you full print and apply
capabilities - just in a smaller footprint. It's ideal for small labels and small spaces as well as

apply, label application, and packing slip automation equipment is second to none.

[Explore Equipment][55]

# Innovative Designs

Our in-house engineers are experts in designing labeling equipment and customized labeling systems
to meet and exceed user expectations.

[Discover How][56]

# More Than Equipment

Because having the right equipment is just part of the labeling equation, FOX IV supplies labels,
ribbons, and inks to match your specific labeling application.

[Explore Supplies][57]

Highly trained service and support technicians, training, and maintenance programs are available to
help keep your labeling equipment running flawlessly.  

[Learn More][58]

# Experience Matters

Over the past 30 years, we've evaluated and implemented many straightforward as well as complex
labeling applications.  Trust our experience to make your labeling application a success.

[Learn More][59]

## Explore Our Labeling Systems and Solutions

### 5961 Compact Label Print and Apply

Small but Powerful! The 5961 label print and apply system gives you full print and apply
capabilities - just in a smaller footprint. It's ideal for small labels and small spaces as well as
lower throughput applications.

[Learn More][60]

### 6955/6957 Series 8 Zebra Based Label Print and Apply

The FOX IV 6955 and 6957 are the go-to choices for general purpose automated print and apply
labeling. They are built with Zebra OEM print engines and are adaptable to most labeling
applications. Useful for shipping, pallet, product, drum, and inventory labeling applications plus
other applications.

[Learn More][61]

### 8008 Wide Label Print and Apply

Print and apply labels up to 8.75" wide with FOX IV's Large Label Print and Apply system, including
8.5" x 11" labels, drum, pallet, chemical, and other wide label applications.

[Learn More][62]
[View Products][63]

"We Solve the Tough Ones...Globally" is not just a motto, it's what happens at FOX IV every day. 
For over 30 years, FOX IV has been designing, manufacturing, and supporting the worlds most
innovative labeling equipment including our print and apply labeling systems.  Our dedicated,
in-house team of mechanical, electrical, and software engineers scrutinize each label application to
determine the best solution.  Not only do we provide standard labeling machines, but we welcome
unique and complex applications that others turn away. 

[Learn More][64]

As a leading manufacturer of print and apply labeling solutions, FOX IV's capabilities include
automated labeling equipment and system design, custom labeling solutions, hardware and
software integration, and labeling supplies.

required for the labeling application.

### Labels, Ribbons, Inks

To meet sustainability and environmental initiatives,  FOX IV is exploring equipment designs and

### Logistics Warehouse Equipment

With the improvement of living standards, logistics and transportation occupy an increasingly
important position in social and economic development. However, logistics companies still have many
problems, such as: management processes are not smooth, information transmission is not in place,
transportation resources are scattered, fleet management is inefficient, etc. This extensive
business model leads to low operational efficiency, high costs, and low profits in the logistics
industry, transportation capacity is scattered, service quality is poor, and development is slow.
In view of the current situation where the number of express delivery items is huge, space is
limited, labor efficiency has reached a bottleneck, and the transfer efficiency cannot be improved
by adding labor, it has become a reality for automated logistics transfer to replace intensive
manual operations. Become the inevitable choice for the world's logistics companies. Automated
logistics transfer solutions can provide express logistics companies with accurate billing basis,
real-time sorting information, reasonable vehicle management and long-term historical data. As the
core system in the express delivery stage, it operates stably and efficiently, with accurate and
timely data, providing basic information for express sorting, cost settlement, logistics
traceability, etc.

### Packing Machine

As a leading enterprise in the packaging machinery industry, Gosunm leverages two decades of
dedicated R&D experience to deliver intelligent packaging solutions to over 2,000 enterprises across
more than 30 countries. Backed by an international team of 200 skilled professionals and over 80
patented technologies, we offer industry-leading capabilities with high-speed output ranging from
200 to 1,000 units per minute and ultra-precise packaging accuracy of ±0.2mm.
We provide comprehensive packaging solutions for a wide range of sectors including food,
pharmaceuticals, personal care, electronics, and logistics—covering the entire process from carton
sealing, wrapping, filling, labeling to palletizing.
Our independently developed servo control systems and AI-based vision inspection technology ensure
that our equipment maintains superior performance. Standard models can be delivered within 7 days,
and customized solutions are completed within 30 working days. Each major project is supported by a
dedicated team of engineers, following through from on-site evaluation to installation and
commissioning.
Whether you require aseptic packaging for the food and beverage industry, GMP-compliant systems for
pharmaceuticals, anti-static precision packaging for electronics, or smart sorting and packaging
lines for e-commerce logistics, our expert team will tailor the most optimized solution to meet your
needs.

### Kraft Paper Tape Sealing Machine

As a professional manufacturer of environmentally friendly packaging automation equipment, gosunm
focuses on the research and development and production of fully automatic water-activated kraft
paper tape machines, aiming to provide efficient, environmentally friendly, and reliable carton
opening and sealing solutions for the modern logistics and e-commerce industries.
Our fully automatic water-activated tape machine is designed to replace traditional plastic tape
sealing, providing stronger adhesion, better tamper-proof performance, and more environmentally
friendly packaging. The system integrates automatic tape feeding, wetting, cutting, and sealing
functions, ensuring consistent and high-quality carton sealing.
Our fully automatic kraft paper tape machines are widely used in e-commerce warehouses, logistics
distribution centers, and manufacturing facilities. Key advantages include high-speed operation,
strong sealing performance, reduced material waste, and user-friendly operation—helping businesses
achieve sustainable and cost-effective packaging solutions.

One-stop Intelligent Automation Solution
Gosunm is committed to providing overall automation solutions. It currently has three major

### Warehousing and logistics equipment division:

Environmentally friendly wet kraft paper carton sealing machine, cartoning and sealing production

### Labeling machine division:

Labeling machine, printing and labeling machine, visual detect labeling machine, sleeve and shrink

### Packaging Production Line Division:

### Logistics Warehouse Equipment

With the improvement of living standards, logistics and transportation occupy an increasingly
important position in social and economic development. However, logistics companies still have many
problems, such as: management processes are not smooth, information transmission is not in place,
transportation resources are scattered, fleet management is inefficient, etc. This extensive
business model leads to low operational efficiency, high costs, and low profits in the logistics
industry, transportation capacity is scattered, service quality is poor, and development is slow.
In view of the current situation where the number of express delivery items is huge, space is
limited, labor efficiency has reached a bottleneck, and the transfer efficiency cannot be improved
by adding labor, it has become a reality for automated logistics transfer to replace intensive
manual operations. Become the inevitable choice for the world's logistics companies. Automated
logistics transfer solutions can provide express logistics companies with accurate billing basis,
real-time sorting information, reasonable vehicle management and long-term historical data. As the
core system in the express delivery stage, it operates stably and efficiently, with accurate and
timely data, providing basic information for express sorting, cost settlement, logistics
traceability, etc.

### Packing Machine

As a leading enterprise in the packaging machinery industry, Gosunm leverages two decades of
dedicated R&D experience to deliver intelligent packaging solutions to over 2,000 enterprises across
more than 30 countries. Backed by an international team of 200 skilled professionals and over 80
patented technologies, we offer industry-leading capabilities with high-speed output ranging from
200 to 1,000 units per minute and ultra-precise packaging accuracy of ±0.2mm.
We provide comprehensive packaging solutions for a wide range of sectors including food,
pharmaceuticals, personal care, electronics, and logistics—covering the entire process from carton
sealing, wrapping, filling, labeling to palletizing.
Our independently developed servo control systems and AI-based vision inspection technology ensure
that our equipment maintains superior performance. Standard models can be delivered within 7 days,
and customized solutions are completed within 30 working days. Each major project is supported by a
dedicated team of engineers, following through from on-site evaluation to installation and
commissioning.
Whether you require aseptic packaging for the food and beverage industry, GMP-compliant systems for
pharmaceuticals, anti-static precision packaging for electronics, or smart sorting and packaging
lines for e-commerce logistics, our expert team will tailor the most optimized solution to meet your
needs.

### Kraft Paper Tape Sealing Machine

As a professional manufacturer of environmentally friendly packaging automation equipment, gosunm
focuses on the research and development and production of fully automatic water-activated kraft
paper tape machines, aiming to provide efficient, environmentally friendly, and reliable carton
opening and sealing solutions for the modern logistics and e-commerce industries.
Our fully automatic water-activated tape machine is designed to replace traditional plastic tape
sealing, providing stronger adhesion, better tamper-proof performance, and more environmentally
friendly packaging. The system integrates automatic tape feeding, wetting, cutting, and sealing
functions, ensuring consistent and high-quality carton sealing.
Our fully automatic kraft paper tape machines are widely used in e-commerce warehouses, logistics
distribution centers, and manufacturing facilities. Key advantages include high-speed operation,
strong sealing performance, reduced material waste, and user-friendly operation—helping businesses
achieve sustainable and cost-effective packaging solutions.

## Recalibrating the Production Lines of the Future

Gulfood Manufacturing 2026 stands as the region’s definitive platform for advancing food security
through industrial strength, bringing the full F&B manufacturing ecosystem together from
next-generation ingredients to advanced processing, packaging, automation, and supply-chain systems
at a time when the UAE is accelerating localisation, expanding domestic production, and investing in
future-ready technologies.

Taking place from **3–5 November 2026 at Dubai World Trade Centre,** this edition reinforces the
nation’s commitment to building a resilient, high-capacity food system powered by innovation,
industrial capability, and strong regional value chains. It is where manufacturers, technology
leaders, ingredient specialists, and industry decision-makers converge to scale capability, deepen
production excellence, and unlock new opportunities in one of the world’s most strategically driven
food-manufacturing markets. For every stakeholder, this is the moment to engage with a country
shaping its food future through action, investment, and industrial ambition.

61,907 Industry professionals

21 Halls of ground-breaking innovations

## Sectors Defining the Future of F&B Manufacturing

### Processing

Production lines are being redefined by speed, precision and adaptability. The shift towards
autonomous, high-efficiency manufacturing is no longer future-facing, it is operational.

Explore advanced processing environments where inspection, forming, dosing and thermal systems work
in sync to maximise throughput and minimise waste. From X-ray inspection and temperature control to
cutting, moulding and laboratory-grade testing systems, every stage of production is engineered for
accuracy, consistency and scale.

Explore More

### Packaging

Packaging now sits at the intersection of regulation, sustainability and brand accountability. It is
no longer a final step, it is a strategic lever.

Discover packaging solutions that balance performance with compliance, from aseptic systems and
high-speed bottling lines to form-fill-seal technologies and intelligent, sustainable materials.
Whether through modified atmosphere packaging, vacuum sealing or smart labelling, manufacturers are
extending shelf life while meeting evolving global standards.

Explore More

### Ingredients

Reformulation is now a business-critical function. From functional performance to cost stability,
ingredients are shaping how products compete, scale and adapt.

Access the next generation of bio-engineered, functional and clean-label ingredients designed to
enhance nutritional value, improve shelf life and deliver consistency at scale. From enzyme
preparations and stabilisers to flavours, essential oils and advanced sweetening systems,
manufacturers are leveraging precision formulation to navigate commodity volatility.

Explore More

### Automation & Control

F&B manufacturing is becoming fully data-driven. The ability to monitor, predict and optimise in
real time is transforming how factories perform.

Integrate intelligent systems that connect sensors, robotics and cloud-based platforms into a
unified operational layer. With digital twins, image recognition and advanced data analytics working
alongside SCADA and IoT networks, manufacturers can achieve precise control, reduce downtime and
continuously optimise performance.

Thanks to the modular design of HERMA labeling machines, even the most individual labeling
requirements can be met.
